discovery_notes: Follow-up to packet 255 (b077) reusing its keys; checked 254, 278, 260 (no shared new items). 30 standard searches, snippets only. New: Haunted Mansion stretching portraits x3 (Sep 2021), Boba Fett throne, Child blue macarons, Child frogs, X-Wing, SW characters puzzle set, WandaVision TV + 2 Scarlet Witch + Agatha brooch (scope hold), Fox and Hound logo spinner, Pooh & Piglet balloons set (Loungefly, structure hold), Alice door, Loungefly Hercules Muses column, Hercules & Megara heart, Thumper sleeping. Makers resolved: Pumpkin Spice Mickey/Pluto, Minnie peppermint mocha, Pooh recycled series (Uncas). Mandalorian wreath subject hold released (Mando), maker held. Stitch holiday year held.
